name: San Francisco SPCA - Community Clinic
description: Affordable preventative care, including vaccines, parasite protection, and treatment for minor conditions
fullDescription: The SF SPCA's Community Veterinary Clinic in the Excelsior neighborhood provides affordable preventative care, including vaccines, parasite protection, and treatment for minor conditions.
whatTheyOffer:
- Dog and cat vaccines
- Flea, tick, and heartworm medication
- Treatment for minor skin, ear, and eye issues
- Treatment for minor illnesses such as vomiting and diarrhea
- Spay/neuter consultations and scheduling (surgery done at the Mission Campus hospital)
- Does not provide emergency care, x-rays, lab work, or health certificates
- Se habla español; Chinese spoken
howToGetIt:
1. Book an appointment online or text 415-554-3084
2. Bring your pet to 4527 Mission Street at your scheduled time (open Wednesday-Saturday, 8 am-6 pm)
3. Pay fees at time of service
keywords: SF SPCA, San Francisco SPCA, Community Clinic, Excelsior, wellness exam, vaccinations, flea, tick, heartworm, affordable vet
